title: Della Rosa Woodfire Range 24H Fermentation $5.50 (Half-Price) @ Coles
body:
Deal: Della Rosa Woodfire Range 24H Fermentation $5.50 (Half-Price) @ Coles

[hexedhavoc] These are really good, trio is best imo. Only downside is a lot of sodium
[Zaddo] I have to agree. These are the best frozen pizza's I have had.
[AdrianW] Trio must be good - there were none at our local Coles, so I had to get the other two varieties.
[G-rig] Jesus not wrong.. 2,892mg sodium if you eat the whole thing, which everyone will.
One should aim for 1600mg max per day (or under 2300mg in some recommended RDI).
Almost 10g saturated fat is bad and processed/red meat is a type 2a carcinogen.
[Mokr] Destination Italy didn't taste good as dr o
[nunyabizzness] You gotta be joking. The base of Dr oetker is like a biscuit
[9674784] I’d say so now, yes.
I honestly feel like Destination Italy has either cut their sauce quantity in half or changed their recipe since they first released.
They taste so dry now.
[mkh1991] They taste a bit sweeter. The chicken ones!!
[SeanConnery] Has anyone tried this specific Destination Italy Salami one?
https://www.coles.com.au/product/destination-italy-salame-pi…
[StarDust88] These are worth it even at full price; at half price, these are a bargain! I mean: wood-fired, 24-hour fermentation, etc…
[Fistov Stone] Try the 'ItalPizza - Numero Uno' from ALDI, $6.99. The base won't disappoint.
[MrMaestro] How do these compare to Italpizza Numero Uno Margherita that Aldi sells? I haven’t bothered to make pizza from fresh since I discovered those.
[GS9891] Better than just getting a freshly made pepperoni at domino's for the same price?
[G-rig] Dom's $5 value range every day were worth it. I'd still just go doms if you have one close by for $7-8, these small frozen pizzas aren't that cheap.
